appearance.summary: A tall, slender young woman (23-24 in Pariah) with black hair and large dark eyes. Teke calls her beautiful ('those eyes, that mouth'). She is a near-copy of the original Alizebeth Bequin, who was tall, dark-haired and very beautiful. She wears a dial-cuff that controls her blankness and constantly changes disguises (Laurael Raeside, Padua Prate, Violetta Flyde), so no single outfit defines her.

evidence.claim: tall, slender, black hair, large dark eyes (Pariah ch. 2)
clone of Alizebeth Bequin, looks almost exactly like the original
original Bequin was tall, dark-haired and very beautiful
Teke: 'My, but you're beautiful... Those eyes, that mouth'
aged 23 at the start of Pariah
fires Judika's laspistol; wears a blankness-control cuff/bracelet
uses the cover names Laurael Raeside and Padua Prate (Pariah) and Violetta Flyde (Penitent)

appearance.summary: A muscular, imposing former temple guard. He has black hair parted in the middle, a beard and dark clothing. As a Curst, the sins he has taken on are tattooed on his skin, covering him from the neck to at least the hips. He carries a heavy hard-round revolver, a Lammark Combination Thousander.

evidence.claim: black hair with a centre parting, beard, dark clothing, muscular body (Pariah ch. 16)
covered in penance tattoos from neck to at least the hips (Pariah ch. 19)

appearance.summary: Never seen on the page. Bequin is nearly taken before him in the City of Dust but escapes first. His name in Lilean Chase's book begins 'Constantin Valdor', but the books never describe his appearance. The form 'human' is only a placeholder.

appearance.summary: A winged, angel-like Blood Angel almost twice the size of a mortal, with silk-white feathered wings about five metres across, porcelain-white skin and long, bedraggled black hair. When the Red Thirst takes him he bares fangs. He fights naked, with no clothes or armour, and kills an armoured Night Lord with his bare hands. The palette is left empty because he wears no Blood Angels armour.

silk-white wings ~5 m span; porcelain-white skin; long, black, bedraggled hair; fangs; almost twice mortal size

has no clothes or armour
wings able to lift his massive body

appearance.summary: A hulking 'warblind' killgang chief who watches the holloways with a big cattle dog. He is nearly as big as Teke, wears plate armour and a buzzing optic visor, and fights with an oil-dark broadsword. His scarred, ridged face is a mask: when it tears, a handsome, noble face shows beneath, and he names himself 'Alpharius' (Alpha Legion). The palette is Alpha Legion colours; the books do not describe his armour colours.

evidence.claim: almost as big as Teke; optic visor; plate armour; oil-dark broadsword; cattle dog
visor smashed; scarred, ridged facial tissue was a mask over a handsome, noble face; 'I am Alpharius'
wears a false face; Alpha Legion; has a hound
massive man fighting alongside a dog against Chaos Space Marines
veteran of the Orphaeic wars (Pariah p.38, French ed.)

appearance.summary: A tall, slender young man with curly black hair. He graduated from the Maze Undue a few years ahead of Beta, and Teke calls him beautiful. After the Word Bearer blade wounds him he looks pale and ill, hunches as though his ribs hurt, and has a crackling, static-like cough. He carries a laspistol.

appearance.summary: A tall, beautiful woman with long braided black hair. Her face is dusted with white powder, her lips painted red and her eyes lined with kohl. She dresses in black robes of fine spider-silk. Beta grew up thinking of her as tall. The skin is set to pale because of the white face powder.

evidence.claim: tall, beautiful, long braided black hair; white-powdered face, red lipstick, kohl-rimmed eyes; black robes of fine spider-silk (Pariah ch. 4)

appearance.summary: An inhumanly tall, powerfully built Emperor's Children marine with an entirely hairless, oiled body and gold pupils. He never stops smiling, and the smile shows perfect alabaster-white teeth. He also has an alarmingly long tongue. At rest he wears only a loincloth, or a soft pink bodyglove made from rose petals. For battle he wears pink and glossy-black power armour edged with gold filigree, and his two gold silk ribbons become slender golden longswords.

evidence.claim: powerful physique, naked but for a loincloth, entirely hairless, oiled; gold pupils; smile with perfect white teeth like alabaster; inhumanly tall
rose petals form a soft pink bodysuit; armour pink and black edged with gold filigree; twin golden longswords from ribbons

no hair, golden pupils, black-and-pink power armour

appearance.summary: A Night Lord sorcerer of the Immaterial College who fights bareheaded. Psychic wings of skeletal red light, bat-like in one summary, spread from him like a billowing cloak. He wields a 'saintie', a staff weapon with a spear blade and mace head; one French summary instead says lightning claws and a bolter. The palette is Night Lords midnight blue.

evidence.claim: no helmet; haggard gleeful face; long tousled grey hair; black-on-black eyes; wings of skeletal red light; saintie (spear blade + mace head)
